source.author: ov
source.text: Quem ratus Astyages etiamnum vivere, longo ense ferit: sonuit tinnitibus ensis acutis.
source.text_original: Quem ratus Astyages etiamnum vivere, longo / ense ferit: sonuit tinnitibus ensis acutis.
source.text_english: Thinking Astyages still alive, he strikes him with his long sword: the sword rang with sharp clashing sounds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Whom does he strike with his sword?
